questions: QuoteAPI|on_screening_outage (gap:declared:OD-1): What is the required behaviour when ScreeningService.screen fails due to an outage? Should the quote be refused, held, retried, or return a specific error status, and must any notification be sent?

response|hold_presence (UNKNOWN): For responses with status `review_hold`, must the API include a dedicated `hold`-related field or any additional payload beyond `status`, optional `quote_id`, and (per DT-S) no `price`? If so, what is its name, type, and population rule?
claims: On storage failure nothing else runs and the response status must be `error: store_unavailable`. [A:dt:QuoteAPI|on_store_failure@v1]
On invalid requests, status must be `rejected: invalid_request` and no store, screen, price or notification occurs. [A:dt:invalid_request|behaviour@v1]
The processing order is strictly validate → store → screen → decide → price → notify → respond. [A:spec:flow|order@v1]

Accept-screened quotes (risk_index <= 41) are priced, notified with a quote document, and have status `quoted`. [A:dt:S-accept|max@v1] [A:dt:S-accept|priced@v1] [A:dt:S-accept|notified@v1] [A:dt:S-accept|status@v1]

Review-screened quotes (42 <= risk_index <= 66) are not priced, not notified, and have status `review_hold`. [A:dt:S-review|min@v1] [A:dt:S-review|max@v1] [A:dt:S-review|priced@v1] [A:dt:S-review|notified@v1] [A:dt:S-review|status@v1]

Refused-screening quotes (risk_index >= 67) are not priced, are notified with a refusal notice, and have status `refused_screening`. [A:dt:S-refuse|min@v1] [A:dt:S-refuse|priced@v1] [A:dt:S-refuse|notified@v1] [A:dt:S-refuse|status@v1]
Notification is fire-and-forget: failures do not change stored quotes or responses. [A:dt:QuoteAPI|on_notification_failure@v1]

The pricing formula is base = 0.87 * weight_kg + 1.13 * distance_km, plus heavy surcharge 316.00 if weight_kg > 1244, then multiplied by 1.19 if distance_km >= 4912, finally rounded to 2 decimal places. [A:dt:P1|formula@v1] [A:dt:P2|threshold@v1] [A:dt:P2|surcharge@v1] [A:dt:P3|threshold@v1] [A:dt:P3|factor@v1] [A:dt:P3|order@v1] [A:dt:P4|rounding@v1]

Validation constraints: shipper_id present and non-empty; 3 <= weight_kg <= 19400; 25 <= distance_km <= 7150; 50 <= declared_value <= 83000. [A:dt:shipper_id|present@v1] [A:dt:weight_kg|min@v1] [A:dt:weight_kg|max@v1] [A:dt:distance_km|min@v1] [A:dt:distance_km|max@v1] [A:dt:declared_value|min@v1] [A:dt:declared_value|max@v1]
The response must contain `quote_id` whenever a draft was successfully stored, and `price` only for priced rows of DT-S. [A:spec:response|quote_id_presence@v1] [A:spec:response|price_presence@v1]
